title: music.listen v1
description: One observed music play/listen event. Item IDs are deterministic and recomputable from the stored item: ULID time bits from the envelope ts (the provider's raw event timestamp, e.g. Spotify played_at), random bits from the first 80 bits of sha256('provider|ts|track.providerUri'). startedAt may be inferred from ts and durationMs (confidence: inferred).

provider.description: Open-world provider slug, e.g. spotify, lastfm, apple-music, local.

track.description: Snapshot of the track as observed. No item pointer is stored: the referenced music.track item's ID is derived from provider|providerUri.

type.description: Open-world context kind, e.g. album, artist, playlist, show, collection.

source.description: How the observation was obtained, e.g. recently-played, import, manual, scrobble.
